items.source: Registers an OpenAiHttpClientBuilderCustomizer that mutates the underlying OkHttp client builder before the OpenAI clients are constructed. Use this to attach OkHttp interceptors (e.g. OAuth2 bearer-token injection), swap the dispatcher executor, or tweak any other OkHttp setting. Customizers are applied in the order they are registered, after Spring AI's own defaults, so user code wins.
items.translation: 注册一个 OpenAiHttpClientBuilderCustomizer，该自定义器会在构建 OpenAI 客户端之前修改底层的 OkHttp 客户端构建器。您可以使用此功能附加 OkHttp 拦截器（例如注入 OAuth2 访问令牌）、替换分发器执行器，或调整任何其他 OkHttp 设置。自定义器按注册顺序应用，在 Spring AI 自身的默认配置之后生效，因此用户代码具有最高优先级。

items.source: Sets the full list of customizers to apply, replacing any customizers registered earlier on this builder. The order of the list is preserved when invoking the customizers.
items.translation: 设置要应用的customizers完整列表，替换在此构建器上先前注册的任意自定义器。调用自定义器时保留列表的顺序。
